title: Astro Portal API v1 project resources
description: A project is the unit of intention that sits above the night plans: one target or one saved framing, an integration goal, and the snapshot of what a new night inherits (place, equipment, constraints). `project` is an internal name: an observer reads « plan multi-nuits ». The night plans stay the unit of execution; the link is carried by each plan item's optional `projectId` (`plan.schema.json`, `planItem`), never by the plan. A project carries no progress: progress is computed from the nights' debriefings. Writing one needs `planner.mosaic`; reading never does. One project read alone also carries the integrations Astro Sync sent for it, their totals by filter and the image of the plan (`integration.schema.json`). A night already run, or a plan of one night, is attached to a multi-night plan of its target afterwards (`POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/nights`, `nightsWrite`), detached (`DELETE …/nights/{nightId}`), or brought into a new one (`POST /v1/projects`, `create`); the project read alone lists its `nights`. See api/v1.md, section « Projects », and projects.md.

status.description: `active` while nights are still being planned; `finished` when the person says the goal is reached or stops it; `archived` only through `DELETE` (it hides the project from the current lists, never its nights).

target.description: The one target of the project: a catalogue object (`targetId`) or a saved framing (`framingId`), exactly one of the two. `name` is the designation shown first (« NGC 7000 »), `commonName` the common name under it (« Nébuleuse de l’Amérique du Nord »).

place.description: The observing place a new night inherits. `horizonMask` is the place's mask as the planner stores it; the server writes it back on the 36-point grid (`normaliseHorizonMask`).

constraints.description: The plan's own constraints, in degrees: the minimum altitude, the minimum separation from the Moon, and that minimum by filter name (an empty object when no filter has its own).

write.description: The body of `PUT /v1/projects/{projectId}`. `status` is optional: absent, a creation is `active` and an update keeps the current status (an archived project stays archived); `active` or `finished` sets it, which also brings an archived project back. `archived` is never written here: `DELETE` archives.

equipment.description: The plan's equipment object (`plan.schema.json`, payload `equipment`), stored as given.

create.description: The body of `POST /v1/projects`, a creation that needs no `If-Match`: the fields of `write`, an optional `id` (generated by the service when absent), and « à partir de plans déjà existants » the nights of the journal (`fromSessionIds`) and the plans of one night (`fromPlanIds`) of the target to attach in the same request. Every night and plan is checked before the project is created: nothing is created unless all can be attached.

idList.description: Identifiers of nights (observation sessions) or of plans, at most fifty; a repeat counts once.

candidates.description: `GET /v1/projects/candidates?targetId=|framingId=`: the nights of the journal and the plans of one night of a target that has no multi-night plan yet, the earliest first, each with `link: null` and `projectId`, the other multi-night plan it already belongs to (or `null`). What « À partir de plans déjà existants » lists before the plan is created; an integration counts for its night whichever plan it follows.

nightsWrite.description: The body of `POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/nights`: the nights of the journal (`sessionIds`) and the plans of one night (`planIds`) to attach, at least one id in all. A night is attached through its plan's item of the target when its plan has one, else by the night itself; a plan of one night through its item of the target.

night.description: One night of a multi-night plan, or one candidate. `sessionId` is the night of the journal (`null` for a plan of one night not run yet), `planId` its plan of one night (`null` for a night run without a plan), `eveningDate` the date of the night (its plan's date, else the evening of its start at its longitude, local noon to local noon). `link` says what carries the link: `plan` (the plan item of the target names the multi-night plan) or `night` (the night itself, when it has no plan item of the target); `null` on a candidate. `integrationCount` and `integrationSeconds` add up the integrations of the night counted for this multi-night plan. `projectId`, on a candidate only, is the other multi-night plan it belongs to, or `null`: attaching it moves it. `state` says where the night stands as the single page of the multi-night plan draws it (« À venir » / « Sessions faites »): `upcoming` (a promise: a plan not run yet, or a session still open or paused), `to_debrief` (the night is over, its debriefing is still to be done: a finished session of a plan without a debriefing, or a plan whose night is past and was not carried out in the application), `done` (debriefed, or a finished session without a plan). Written by the service on every night and every candidate; optional in the schema so that a reader of an earlier answer still validates.

nights.description: `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/nights`, and the answer of `POST …/nights` and `DELETE …/nights/{nightId}`: the nights of the plan, the earliest first, and the candidates — the nights of the journal and the plans of one night of the same target that are not among them, the earliest first.

integrations.description: On `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}` only, never on the list: the integrations Astro Sync sent for the plan, the earliest night first (`integration.schema.json`).

totalsByFilter.description: The integrations added up by filter, computed by the service; with `integrations`.

planCapture.description: The image of the multi-night plan (the newest capture of role `plan`, `uploads.md`), `null` when Astro Sync sent none; with `integrations`.

planCaptureCount.description: How many images of the plan the space holds (the newest is `planCapture`); with `integrations`.

allSessionsDone.description: With `nights` (on `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}` and on the answer of `POST /v1/projects`, never on the list): true when no night of the plan is `upcoming` or `to_debrief` and at least one is `done`. It is what makes « Image du plan » the action of the page and what lets the Journal group the plan's sessions once the plan is also `finished` (`status`).

nights.description: On `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}` and on the answer of `POST /v1/projects`, never on the list: the nights of the plan, the earliest first — planned from it or attached since.

trashResponse.description: `POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/trash` (web session only), « Supprimer ce plan multi-nuits »: the multi-night plan goes to the trash for `daysRemaining` days with its nights still to come (`planIds`: its plans of one night not run); its nights already run are detached and stay in the Journal as ordinary sessions (`detachedSessionCount`). `409 project_in_progress` (with `planIds`) when one of its nights runs on a device; `{ "force": true }` deletes it anyway, that night with it. `DELETE /v1/projects/{projectId}` still archives.

restoreResponse.description: `POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/restore`: the multi-night plan back from the trash with the plans that went with it (`plansRestored`; one whose night is taken since, or beyond the plan limit, stays in the trash: `plansKept`) and the nights it was detached from, when they are still free.

eraseResponse.description: `POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/erase`: the multi-night plan of the trash erased for good, with the plans that went with it (`plansErased`) and its integrations; its image stays in the captures.

nightsStatistics.description: GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/analyses (w61): the statistics of the nights of a multi-night plan, night by night and together — « Les nuits de cette image » of a capture of the plan. `nights`: each night run of the plan (a plan of one night not run yet is not listed), the earliest first, with its guiding summary and its frames as `GET /v1/sessions/{id}` gives them (`session.schema.json` `guidingSummary`, `posesSummary`), its place's zone and the medians of its frames (`fwhmPixels`, `eccentricity`); `analysed: false` for a night without an analysis. `cumulative`: the analysed nights together — each axis's RMS weighted by the night's guided time (√(Σ tᵢ·rmsᵢ² / Σ tᵢ)), the total from the two axes; frames, times and dithers summed. The traces stay on each night's own read. Never gated by a capability; `404 project_not_found`.

oneOf.description: `GET /v1/projects`: every project of the space, archived ones included.
`DELETE /v1/projects/{projectId}`: the project is archived, never deleted; its nights stay ordinary plans.

A refusal. `409 project_conflict` carries the server's current `project`; `403 capability_required` names the `capability` the write needs. `403 multi_night_not_active` on the nights routes and on `POST /v1/projects` from existing nights names `planner.mosaic` (« Planification avancée »; the integrations of a plan and its image name `analysis.progression`, see integration.schema.json); `409 target_mismatch` and `404 session_not_found` / `plan_not_found` name the `sessionId` or the `planId` refused.
